# Loading Libraries and Data

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(limma)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(ggplot2)
library(sva)
library(reshape2)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)

data <- load("SKCM.rda")

# Extract clinical data
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
               ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis)

# Create proper survival object
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate survival time in years
    survival_time = ifelse(vital_status == "Alive", NA, days_to_death / 365),
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    
    # Convert age to years
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  # Handle missing values
  mutate(
    age_diagnosis = ifelse(is.na(age_diagnosis), median(age_diagnosis, na.rm = TRUE), age_diagnosis),
    # ajcc_pathologic_stage = ifelse(is.na(ajcc_pathologic_stage), "Unknown", ajcc_pathologic_stage)
  )

fpkm <- assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand")

log_expr <- log2(fpkm + 1)
```

```{r}
ids <- as.character(colData(query2)$barcode)
batch <- sapply(strsplit(ids, "-"), function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 6) return(x[6]) else return(NA)
})


gene_var <- apply(log_expr, 1, var)
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr[gene_var > 0, ]
```

# Batch Correction

```{r message=FALSE}
# ComBat 
modcombat <- model.matrix(~1, data = data.frame(batch = batch))
combat_expr <- ComBat(dat = as.matrix(log_expr_filtered),
                      batch = batch,
                      mod = modcombat,
                      par.prior = TRUE,
                      prior.plots = FALSE)
```

# Cox Survival Model

```{r}
# Filter to ensure the samples match between clinical and gene expression data
combat_expr_filtered <- combat_expr[, rownames(clinical)]

# Convert relevant character variables to factors
clinical$gender <- as.factor(clinical$gender)
clinical$vital_status <- as.factor(clinical$vital_status)
clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage <- as.factor(clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage)

```


# NEW MODELS 

## Mice



# best with survival plot
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(mice)
library(survival)
library(glmnet)
library(dplyr)
library(survcomp)
library(survminer) # ADDED for ggsurvplot

# Step 1: Prepare clinical data (same as new initial Cox model)
# Ensure categorical variables are factors
clinical$event <- as.factor(clinical$event)
clinical$gender <- as.factor(clinical$gender)
clinical$vital_status <- as.factor(clinical$vital_status)
clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage <- as.factor(clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage)

# Validate event levels
cat("Event levels before cleaning:\n")
print(levels(clinical$event))
if (!all(levels(clinical$event) %in% c("0", "1"))) {
  warning("Unexpected event levels; cleaning to 0/1")
  clinical$event <- factor(clinical$event, levels = c("0", "1"), exclude = NA)
}

# Simplify ajcc_pathologic_stage into Early vs. Late
clinical <- clinical %>%
  mutate(
    stage_simplified = factor(
      case_when(
        ajcc_pathologic_stage %in% c("Stage I", "Stage IA", "Stage IB", "Stage II", "Stage IIA", "Stage IIB", "Stage IIC") ~ "Early",
        ajcc_pathologic_stage %in% c("Stage III", "Stage IIIA", "Stage IIIB", "Stage IIIC", "Stage IV", "Unknown") ~ "Late",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("Early", "Late")
    )
  )

# Filter NA values and invalid survival_time
clinical <- clinical %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & survival_time > 0 & !is.na(event))
cat("After filtering NAs and invalid survival_time:\n")
cat("Summary of survival_time:\n")
print(summary(clinical$survival_time))
cat("Event counts:\n")
print(table(clinical$event, useNA = "always"))
cat("Number of events:", sum(clinical$event == "1", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Step 2: Impute clinical data
imp <- mice(
  clinical %>%
    select(gender, vital_status, stage_simplified, age_diagnosis, survival_time, event),
  m = 5,
  method = c("logreg", "logreg", "logreg", "pmm", "pmm", "logreg"),
  seed = 123,
  printFlag = FALSE
)

# Step 3: Prepare gene expression data
# Align log_expr_filtered with clinical samples
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr_filtered[, rownames(clinical)]

# Filter genes with non-zero variance
gene_var <- apply(log_expr_filtered, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
log_expr_filtered <- log_expr_filtered[gene_var > 0, ]
cat("Number of genes after variance filter:", nrow(log_expr_filtered), "\n")

# Standardize gene expression
log_expr_filtered <- t(scale(t(log_expr_filtered)))

# Step 4: Select genes using Lasso-Cox (pre-imputation)
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(log_expr_filtered))
clinical_subset <- clinical[common_samples, ]
X <- t(log_expr_filtered[, common_samples])
X <- X[, apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-5]

# Check for NAs in survival data
cat("Checking for NAs in survival data:\n")
cat(sum(is.na(clinical_subset$survival_time)), "NAs in survival_time\n")
cat(sum(is.na(clinical_subset$event)), "NAs in event\n")

# Validate event coercion
cat("Validating event coercion:\n")
event_numeric <- as.numeric(clinical_subset$event) - 1
print(table(event_numeric, useNA = "always"))

# Create Surv object
y <- Surv(clinical_subset$survival_time, event_numeric)

set.seed(123)
tryCatch({
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(X, y, family = "cox", alpha = 1, nfolds = 5)
  lasso_coef <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.1se")
  selected_genes <- rownames(lasso_coef)[as.vector(lasso_coef) != 0]
}, error = function(e) {
  warning("Lasso gene selection failed: ", e$message)
  selected_genes <- character(0)
})

if (length(selected_genes) == 0) {
  warning("No genes selected by Lasso; using top 3 genes by variance")
  selected_genes <- names(sort(gene_var, decreasing = TRUE))[1:3]
}
cat("Selected genes:", selected_genes, "\n")

# Subset gene expression
selected_expr <- log_expr_filtered[selected_genes, , drop = FALSE]
selected_expr_t <- t(selected_expr)

# Step 5: Fit Lasso-Cox model for each imputation
lasso_models <- list()
c_indices <- numeric(5)
selected_predictors_list <- list()
risk_scores_list <- list() # ADDED to store risk scores

for (i in 1:5) {
  # Get imputed clinical data
  clin_imp_i <- complete(imp, i)
  
  # Ensure row names match
  clin_imp_i <- clin_imp_i[rownames(clinical), ]
  
  # Combine clinical and gene expression data
  common_patients <- intersect(rownames(clin_imp_i), rownames(selected_expr_t))
  cox_data <- cbind(
    clin_imp_i[common_patients, ] %>% select(gender, stage_simplified, age_diagnosis, survival_time, event),
    selected_expr_t[common_patients, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  
  # Ensure categorical variables are factors
  cox_data$gender <- as.factor(cox_data$gender)
  cox_data$stage_simplified <- as.factor(cox_data$stage_simplified)
  cox_data$event <- as.factor(cox_data$event)
  
  # Filter valid rows
  valid_idx <- which(cox_data$survival_time > 0 & !is.na(cox_data$event))
  if (length(valid_idx) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No valid rows for imputation", i))
    c_indices[i] <- NA
    next
  }
  cox_data_valid <- cox_data[valid_idx, ]
  
  # Convert event to numeric for glmnet
  cox_data_valid$event <- as.numeric(cox_data_valid$event) - 1
  
  # Validate data
  if (any(cox_data_valid$survival_time <= 0, na.rm = TRUE) || any(is.na(cox_data_valid$survival_time))) {
    warning(paste("Invalid survival_time in imputation", i))
    c_indices[i] <- NA
    next
  }
  if (!all(cox_data_valid$event %in% c(0, 1))) {
    warning(paste("Invalid event values in imputation", i))
    c_indices[i] <- NA
    next
  }
  
  # Debug: Check number of events
  cat("Imputation", i, "events:", sum(cox_data_valid$event == 1), "\n")
  
  # Prepare input for glmnet
  x <- cox_data_valid %>% select(-survival_time, -event)
  y <- Surv(cox_data_valid$survival_time, cox_data_valid$event)
  
  # Convert to numeric matrix
  x <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = as.data.frame(x))
  
  # Cross-validated Lasso-Cox
  tryCatch({
    cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family = "cox", alpha = 1, nfolds = 5)
    best_lambda <- cv_fit$lambda.1se
    lasso_model <- glmnet(x, y, family = "cox", alpha = 1, lambda = best_lambda, maxit = 1000)
    
    # Save model
    lasso_models[[i]] <- lasso_model
    
    # Save selected predictors
    selected_coefs <- coef(lasso_model)
    selected_predictors <- selected_coefs[selected_coefs != 0]
    selected_predictors_list[[i]] <- names(selected_predictors)
    
    # Predict linear predictor
    lp <- predict(lasso_model, newx = x, type = "link")
    
    # Compute C-index
    c_index <- concordance.index(x = lp, surv.time = cox_data_valid$survival_time, surv.event = cox_data_valid$event, method = "noether")
    c_indices[i] <- c_index$c.index
    
    # ADDED: Store risk scores with patient_barcode
    risk_scores_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      patient_barcode = rownames(cox_data_valid),
      risk_score = as.numeric(lp)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Error in glmnet for imputation", i, ":", e$message))
    c_indices[i] <- NA
    # ADDED: Store NA risk scores
    risk_scores_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
      patient_barcode = rownames(cox_data_valid),
      risk_score = rep(NA_real_, nrow(cox_data_valid))
    )
  })
}

# Step 6: Summarize results
mean_cindex <- mean(c_indices, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_cindex <- sd(c_indices, na.rm = TRUE)

selected_predictor_counts <- table(unlist(selected_predictors_list))
selected_predictor_counts <- sort(selected_predictor_counts, decreasing = TRUE)

cat("Mean C-index across 5 imputations:", round(mean_cindex, 3), "\n")
cat("SD of C-index:", round(sd_cindex, 3), "\n")
cat("Most frequently selected predictors:\n")
print(selected_predictor_counts)

# ADDED: Average risk scores across imputations
risk_scores_df <- bind_rows(risk_scores_list)
risk_scores_avg <- risk_scores_df %>%
  group_by(patient_barcode) %>%
  summarise(avg_risk_score = mean(risk_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_risk_score))

cat("Prediction results (first 6):\n")
print(head(risk_scores_avg))

# ADDED: Plot survival curve stratified by risk score
cox_data_plot <- cox_data_valid %>%
  mutate(
    risk_group = cut(
      risk_scores_avg$avg_risk_score[match(rownames(cox_data_valid), risk_scores_avg$patient_barcode)],
      breaks = quantile(risk_scores_avg$avg_risk_score, probs = c(0, 0.5, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
      labels = c("Low Risk", "High Risk"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & !is.na(event) & !is.na(risk_group))

# MODIFIED: Save larger plot to a file with adjusted aesthetics
p <- ggsurvplot(
  survfit(Surv(survival_time, event) ~ risk_group, data = cox_data_plot),
  data = cox_data_plot,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  xlab = "Survival Time (Years)",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  title = "Survival Curve by Risk Group",
  legend.labs = c("Low Risk", "High Risk"),
  # Adjust aesthetics for readability
  risk.table.height = 0.3, # Increase risk table height
  ggtheme = theme_minimal(base_size = 16), # Increase base font size
  font.main = c(20, "bold"), # Larger title
  font.x = c(16), # Larger x-axis label
  font.y = c(16), # Larger y-axis label
  font.legend = c(14) # Larger legend text
)

# Save plot to a larger PNG file
png(filename = "mice_survival_plot_avg_risk.png", width = 1200, height = 800, units = "px", res = 150)
print(p)
dev.off()

# Optionally print to console (smaller version)
print(p)
```

```{r}
colnames(clinical)[grepl("day|follow|death", colnames(clinical), ignore.case = TRUE)]


```
Solution Options:
Option 1: Use only deceased patients (not ideal)

This leads to biased survival analysis, since no censoring is modeled. Best avoided unless absolutely necessary.
✅ Option 2: Get follow-up times for survivors

Check if there's a field like days_to_last_contact in the full clinical dataset (not just your current clinical object). If you're working from TCGA, that info is often in the original XML or BCR-annotated files.

In the meantime, if you're limited to just days_to_death, you can proceed with a limited example, treating only deceased cases — but clearly document this limitation.
